camel_example: aliyun ens RevokeSecurityGroupEgress --region cn-hangzhou --Policy accept --PortRange '22/22' --SourcePortRange '22/22' --Priority 1 --SecurityGroupId 'sg-bp67acfmxazb4ph000' --IpProtocol all --DestCidrIp '10.0.0.0/8'
description_en: Deletes an outbound security group rule. After the rule is deleted, the access control implemented by the rule is removed
description_zh: 调用RevokeSecurityGroupEgress删除一条出方向安全组规则，撤销安全组出方向的访问权限
kebab_example: aliyun ens revoke-security-group-egress --ip-protocol all --port-range 22/22 --security-group-id sg-bp67acfmxazb4ph000 --policy accept --priority 1 --dest-cidr-ip 10.0.0.0/8 --source-port-range 22/22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress

parameters.help_en:
The transport layer protocol. The value of this parameter is case-sensitive. Valid values:

tcp

udp

icmp

gre

all: All protocols are supported
parameters.help_zh:
传输层协议。取值大小写敏感。取值范围：
tcp
udp
icmp
gre
all：支持所有协议
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The range of destination ports that correspond to the transport layer protocol for the security group rule. Valid values:

If you set the IpProtocol parameter to tcp or udp, the port number ranges from 1 to 65535. The start port number and the end port number are separated by a forward slash (/). Correct example: 1/200. Incorrect example: 200/1.

When the IpProtocol parameter is set to icmp, the port number range is -1/-1, which indicates all ports.

When the IpProtocol parameter is set to gre, the port number range is -1/-1, which indicates all ports.

When the IpProtocol parameter is set to all, the port number range is -1/-1, which indicates all ports
parameters.help_zh:
目的端安全组开放的传输层协议相关的端口范围。取值范围：
TCP/UDP协议：取值范围为1~65535。使用斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。正确示范：1/200；错误示范：200/1。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
IpProtocol取值为all：-1/-1
parameters.name: port_range

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The action of the security group rule. Valid values:

accept: allows access.

drop: denies access and returns no responses.

Default value: accept
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问权限。取值：
accept：接受访问。
drop：拒绝访问，不返回拒绝信息。

默认值：accept
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the security group rule. Valid values: 1 to 100. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
安全组规则优先级。取值范围：1~100，数值越小，代表优先级越高。

默认值：1
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The destination IP addresses. CIDR blocks and IPv4 addresses are supported.

By default, this parameter is empty
parameters.help_zh:
目的端IP地址范围。支持CIDR格式和IPv4格式的IP地址范围。

默认值：无
parameters.name: dest_cidr_ip

ICMP协议：-1/-1。
GRE协议：-1/-1。
